name: Insurance M&A deals
description: Every insurance and insurtech acquisition, merger and controlling-stake purchase reported in the trade press, deduplicated into one row per deal. Counted whether or not a price was disclosed — most never are. A floor on real activity, not a market estimate.
terms: Free to use with attribution to Insurtech Daily and a link to https://insurtechdaily.io/ma/.

fields.acquirer: Company acquiring, as canonicalised by this site where it has a page here.
fields.acquirer_url: The acquirer's page here. Blank where the archive holds no record of it.
fields.target: Company, book or business unit being acquired.
fields.target_url: The target's page here. Blank where the archive holds no record of it.
fields.seller: Party disposing of the target, where the deal is a divestment and a headline names one. Blank otherwise.
fields.deal_type: Acquisition, Merger, Majority stake or Asset purchase, read from the reporting.
fields.price_disclosed: yes where a price was published, no otherwise. Most acquisition prices never are.
fields.amount_usd_millions: Price in millions of US dollars, converted at a fixed reference rate. Empty where undisclosed — never zero.
fields.amount_reported_millions: The same price in millions of the currency the outlet printed. Empty where undisclosed.
fields.reported_currency: ISO code of the currency the outlet printed. Empty where undisclosed.
fields.announced: Date the deal was reported, YYYY-MM-DD. A deal is reported again as it clears and completes; this is the report this row was built from.
fields.source: Outlet this row was taken from.
fields.source_url: The report it comes from — check it before citing.
fields.also_reported_by: Other outlets that covered the same deal, semicolon-separated.
